profile_text.body:
Micron Technology is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU, that describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage. Per its own site, it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions, and its mobile memory and storage are said to accelerate AI-driven technologies for end users. The site presents design tools and resources for testing, building, and maintaining high-performance solutions, downloadable data sheets and technical documentation, an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples, and a Technology Enablement Program (TEP) for enrollment.

The company's AI position, as it frames it, rests on memory and storage hardware rather than on software products. Its site organizes material around product specifications, design support, and sales support, with mobile memory and storage positioned as the layer that enables predictive and insightful experiences for end users.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Idaho, with 21 entries. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it in the material reviewed.
